# 0.9.0-alpha02

> **Alpha, checked on an emulator only.** Unit tests pass on both flavours. The new calendar was looked at on an emulator; the rest of this build has not been on a real phone, and the direct-link playback and the MyAnimeList copy have not been run against a real account. Expect bugs and report them on GitHub.
>
> Version `0.9.0-alpha02` (`1900002`). Installs as **Editotsu α** (`ani.editotsu.beta`) and updates alpha01 in place.

- **New Features:**
  - Calendar redrawn as a calendar
    - A strip with the days of the week on top: weekday, date, how many episodes air, today marked
    - Each day is a list in airing order with the time, cover with its score, title and episode; shows on your list say so and how far you are
    - One labelled filter (Everything, My list, Dubbed) replaces the two unlabelled buttons
    - Times follow the phone's 12- or 24-hour setting
  - A source can hand the app a direct link for a torrent release
    - When a source says it may have one, the app asks it as you pick the release and plays the link; otherwise the torrent plays as before
    - Releases the source already has ready are marked **Instant**
  - Copy your AniList lists to MyAnimeList
    - Settings > Accounts, on the MyAnimeList card: compares both lists, tells you how many entries differ, and updates MyAnimeList after you confirm
    - One way only: entries that exist only on MyAnimeList are kept and AniList is never changed
  - The player library with Vulkan rendering is part of every build, so the larger upscaler models are available
  - Upscaler descriptions rewritten: what each model gives and what it costs

- **Bugfixes:**
  - Calendar: with a filter on, days with nothing matching were removed, so the day you were on became another date
  - Updating an extension said "updated" when nothing was installed; it now reports a cancelled or failed install, and the repository list is refreshed before an update so it no longer needs a manual refresh first
  - A rewatch was sent to MyAnimeList with a status it does not have
  - The anime and manga list placeholders match the real list, and the tab row has one too
  - Comments turned off: the button now says what it does
  - Extension settings open with a short fade instead of sliding up from the bottom of the screen
